catalog_items_measures_check.name: catalog_items_measures_check
catalog_items_measures_check.value:
(
        ("catalog_items"."net_weight_kg" is null or "catalog_items"."net_weight_kg" >= 0)
        and ("catalog_items"."gross_weight_kg" is null or "catalog_items"."gross_weight_kg" >= 0)
        and ("catalog_items"."length_cm" is null or "catalog_items"."length_cm" >= 0)
        and ("catalog_items"."width_cm" is null or "catalog_items"."width_cm" >= 0)
        and ("catalog_items"."height_cm" is null or "catalog_items"."height_cm" >= 0)
      )

plan_accounts_dre_line_nature_check.name: plan_accounts_dre_line_nature_check
plan_accounts_dre_line_nature_check.value:
(
        ("plan_accounts"."nature" = 'revenue' AND "plan_accounts"."dre_line" IN ('gross_revenue', 'financial_income', 'other_income'))
        OR ("plan_accounts"."nature" = 'expense' AND "plan_accounts"."dre_line" IN ('deduction', 'cost', 'operating_expense', 'financial_expense', 'other_expense'))
        OR ("plan_accounts"."nature" IN ('asset', 'liability', 'equity') AND "plan_accounts"."dre_line" IS NULL)
      ) AND ("plan_accounts"."is_treasury" = false OR "plan_accounts"."nature" = 'asset')
